question.text: According to the model portfolio for a young BPO employee with a high-risk profile, what is the recommended allocation to diversified equity schemes?

explanation.text: The Logic: The model portfolio for the young call centre / BPO high-risk profile allocates 50% to equities / diversified equity schemes, 20% to sector funds, 10% to gold ETF, 10% to debt / fixed deposits, and 10% to short-term debt / liquid / bank. The specific diversified-equity allocation is therefore 50%. The Trap: Option D (70%) is the total equity-oriented allocation when sector funds (20%) are added to diversified equity (50%); the question asks specifically about the diversified equity / equity schemes line. Option A (35%) is the equity allocation in a different model portfolio (young married family / moderate risk). Note: Candidates should memorise each model portfolio line by line, since NISM Series X-B questions often hinge on a single asset-class percentage rather than the aggregate equity exposure.
